blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Source-only domain generalization (DG) for remote sensing semantic segmentation seeks reliable predictions in unseen domains without target-domain data during training. Although vision foundation models offer transferable knowledge, category recognition remains sensitive to source-specific visual cues, while task-specific adaptation may weaken pretrained transferability. We propose ASCoR, an asymmetric semantic-spatial framework built on SAM3. Its text-conditioned semantic branch uses class-name prompts to provide explicit category guidance. Probe-Once Dynamic Adaptive LoRA distributes a fixed adaptation budget across encoder blocks to limit source-specific specialization. A complementary task-specific dense branch learns multi-scale spatial representations using a separate frozen SAM3 image encoder. A lightweight reliability router integrates the two branches through bounded spatial correction based on local prediction reliability. All components are trained using source-domain supervision only. Experiments on the ISPRS, LoveDA, and OpenEarthMap benchmarks cover nine cross-domain transfers. ASCoR achieves a state-of-the-art mean IoU of 68.61% across six ISPRS transfers, outperforming the previous best method by 2.69 percentage points. It also achieves the best results on all three LoveDA/OpenEarthMap transfers, with 59.07%, 47.95%, and 49.38% mIoU on Rural-to-Urban, Urban-to-Rural, and Urban-to-OpenEarthMap, respectively. Ablation studies, feature visualizations, and spatial reliability analyses support the effectiveness and complementarity of the proposed components. Code: https://github.com/WangZitong42/ASCoR.
blocks.zh: 用于遥感语义分解的仅源域通论(DG)在培训期间在没有目标域数据的情况下寻求在未见域中进行可靠的预测. 虽然愿景基础模型提供了可转让的知识,但类别识别仍然对特定源的可视提示敏感,而针对特定任务的适应可能削弱事先经过培训的可转让性。 我们提出ASCoR,一个基于SAM3的不对称语义-空间框架. 它的文字条件语义分支使用类名提示来提供明确的类别指导. Probe-Once Dynamic Adaptive LORA在编码器块之间分配固定的适应预算,以限制特定源的专门化. 一个互补的任务特有密度分支使用单独的被冷冻的SAM3图像编码器来学习多尺度的空间表示. 轻量级可靠性路由器通过基于局部预测可靠性的有界空间校正来将两个分支整合. 所有组件都只使用源域监督进行训练。 关于ISPRS、LoveDA和OpenEarthMap基准的实验涉及9个跨域转移。 ASCOR在6次ISPRS转移中实现了68.61%的最高水平IoU,比以往最佳方法高2.69个百分点。 它还在LoveDA/OpenEarthMap的所有三项转移中取得了最佳成果,分别有59.07%、47.95%和49.38%的MIoU在农村到城市、城市到农村和城市到OpenEarthMap方面。 校正研究、特征可视化和空间可靠性分析支持拟议组成部分的有效性和互补性。 代码:https://github.com/WangZitong42/ASCoR.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Remote sensing semantic segmentation provides pixel-level land-cover information for applications such as urban planning and environmental monitoring ( Zhu et al., 2017 ; Ma et al., 2019 ) . However, models trained on one domain often lose accuracy when deployed elsewhere because differences in geographic regions, imaging sensors, and scene compositions can substantially alter the visual distribution ( Wang et al., 2021 ; Iizuka et al., 2023 ; Liang et al., 2024 ) . This gap between source-domain learning and practical deployment motivates source-only domain generalization (DG), which aims to transfer a model trained on a single labeled source domain to unseen domains without accessing target-domain data during training ( Zhou et al., 2022 ; Rafi et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 遥感语义分解为城市规划和环境监测等应用提供了像素级土地覆盖信息(朱等,2017;马等,2019. 然而,在一个领域受过培训的模型在部署到其他地方时往往会失去准确性,因为地理区域、成像传感器和场景构成的差异会大大改变视觉分布(Wang等,2021;Iizuka等,2023;Liang等,2024)。 源域学习与实际部署之间的这一差距激励了源域通论(DG),该通论旨在将一个在单一有标签的源域上受过训练的模型转移到隐蔽域而无需在训练期间访问目标域数据(周等,2022;拉菲等,2024).

blocks.en: To facilitate such cross-domain transfer, vision foundation models (VFMs), which acquire transferable knowledge through large-scale pretraining, offer a promising basis for extending remote sensing representations beyond the visual regularities of a single source domain ( He et al., 2022 ; Oquab et al., 2024 ; Mendieta et al., 2023 ) . Their relevance to dense prediction becomes more evident as pretrained knowledge encompasses explicit semantic concepts and structural priors: vision-language models associate visual observations with category semantics ( Radford et al., 2021 ) , whereas segmentation foundation models capture object-level spatial structure ( Kirillov et al., 2023 ) . By incorporating concept recognition into promptable segmentation, SAM3 connects these two capabilities, creating an opportunity to guide dense land-cover prediction with explicit category semantics ( Carion et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 为促进这种跨域转让,通过大规模预训获得可转让知识的愿景基础模型为将遥感表示扩展到单一来源域的视觉常态之外提供了有希望的基础(He等,2022;Oquab等,2024;Mendieta等,2023)。 其与密集预测的相关性更加明显,因为预先训练的知识包括明确的语义概念和结构前科:视觉语言模型将视觉观测与类语义联系起来(Radford等,2021年),而分块基础模型则捕捉出物体级空间结构(Kirillov等,2023年)。 通过将概念识别纳入可迅速分解,SAM3将这两种能力联系起来,创造了一个机会,用明确的类语义来引导密集的土地覆盖预测(Carion等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Much of the existing research on remote sensing DG focuses on conventional segmentation networks, whose robustness is improved through appearance diversification or representation regularization ( Iizuka et al., 2023 ; Liang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025b ) . Although these strategies address visual variability, category discrimination remains primarily dependent on source-domain visual observations, leaving predictions vulnerable to changes in class appearance. A smaller body of work introduces VFMs to obtain broader pretrained knowledge through the adaptation of generic visual representations ( Gong et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Within this paradigm, the potential for extracting task-specific spatial evidence that complements category semantics remains insufficiently explored. As illustrated in Fig. 1 (a), these limitations highlight the need for explicit category guidance and a more effective use of pretrained representations for dense spatial prediction.
blocks.zh: 关于遥感DG的现有研究大多侧重于常规分块网络,通过外观多样化或代表正规化,这些分块网络的稳健性得到提高(Iizuka等,2023;Liang等,2024;Wang等,2025b.). 虽然这些策略解决了视觉可变性,但类别歧视仍然主要依赖于源域视觉观察,使得预测易受到阶级外观变化的影响. 一部更小的作品引入了VFM,通过改编通用视觉表现来获得更广泛的预训知识(龚等,2025;张等,2026. 在这一范式中,对提取具体任务空间证据以补充分类语义的潜力仍然没有充分探讨。 如图1(a)所示,这些局限性突出表明,需要明确的类别指导并更有效地利用事先经过培训的表述来进行密集的空间预测。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Motivation and paradigm comparison for source-only remote sensing domain generalization. (a) Limitations of representative visual-driven DG approaches in transferring category semantics and exploiting task-specific dense representations. (b) ASCoR combines text-conditioned semantic guidance with complementary dense spatial learning through an asymmetric SAM3 framework and reliability-guided correction. Earth image credit: NASA/Apollo 17, via Wikimedia Commons (public domain).
blocks.zh: 图1:唯一来源遥感域通论的动机和范式比较. (a) 具有代表性的视觉驱动DG方法在转移类别语义和利用特定任务密集表述方面的局限性。 (b) ASCoR通过不对称SAM3框架和可靠性制导校正,将文字条件语义指导与互补的密集空间学习结合起来。 地球影像信用:NASA/Apollo 17,通过Wikimedia Communications (公有领域).

blocks.en: To solve these problems, we propose ASCoR, an asymmetric semantic–spatial learning framework built on SAM3. Figure 1 (b) contrasts our framework with the representative visual-driven DG paradigm. To strengthen category discrimination beyond source-domain visual cues, we exploit SAM3’s concept-aware segmentation capability to construct a text-conditioned semantic branch (TCSB). By associating dense predictions with class-name prompts, TCSB introduces an explicit semantic reference for recognizing land-cover categories across variations in visual appearance.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这些问题,我们提出ASCoR,一个基于SAM3的不对称语义-空间学习框架. 图1(b)对比了我们的框架和有代表性的视觉驱动的DG范式。 为了强化超越源域视觉提示的类别歧视,我们利用SAM3的概念意识分解能力来构建文字条件语义分支(TCSB). 通过将密集的预测与类名提示联系起来,TCSB引入了明确的语义参考,以识别各种可视外观变化的土地覆盖类别。

blocks.en: To further exploit task-specific spatial information, we develop a complementary task-specific dense branch (TSDB) upon a separate SAM3 encoder whose pretrained weights remain frozen. Multi-scale dense decoding extracts spatially detailed representations from hierarchical features, supported by bounded structure injection that incorporates boundary and geometric cues. Complementary supervision from TCSB directs this learning toward regions where its semantic predictions are less reliable. A lightweight reliability router then estimates the local utility of the dense predictions and applies bounded spatial correction. Together, these components enable task-specific spatial evidence to supplement category-level semantic guidance.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步利用针对特定任务的空间信息,我们在一个单独的SAM3编码器上开发了一个针对特定任务的密集分支(TSDB),该编码器的预受训练重量仍然被冻结. 多尺度密密解码从分层特征中提取出空间上详细的表示,辅以包含边界和几何提示的有界结构注入. TCSB的补充监督将这种学习导向其语义预测不太可靠的区域。 轻量级可靠性路由器然后估计密度预测的局部效用并应用有界限的空间校正. 这些组成部分共同使特定任务的空间证据能够补充类别级语义指导.

blocks.en: We further introduce Probe-Once Dynamic Adaptive LoRA to control adaptation capacity within TCSB. By allocating a constrained low-rank budget across encoder blocks according to their source-task adaptation responses, this strategy supports task-specific learning with limited modification of pretrained representations. The complete framework is optimized exclusively with source-domain supervision.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步引入了探测-旧动态适应LORA,以控制TCSB的适应能力. 通过根据编码器块的源任务适应性反应,将有限的低级预算分配给各块,本战略支持任务特定学习,对事先训练过的表述进行有限的修改. 整个框架完全通过源域监督加以优化。

blocks.en: Extensive experiments on the ISPRS, LoveDA, and OpenEarthMap benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of ASCoR across nine transfers. ASCoR achieves a state-of-the-art average mIoU of 68.61% on six ISPRS transfers, exceeding the previous best method by 2.69 percentage points. It also achieves the best performance on all three LoveDA/OpenEarthMap transfers. Systematic ablations establish the contributions of the proposed components, supported by feature visualizations and spatial reliability analyses that provide insight into their complementary behavior.
blocks.zh: 关于ISPRS、LoveDA和OpenEarthMap基准数据集的广泛实验表明ASCoR在9个传输中的有效性。 ASCoR在6次ISPRS转移中实现了68.61%的最高平均mIoU,超过了以往最佳方法2.69个百分点. 它还在所有3个LoveDA/OpenEarthMap传输上都取得了最佳表现. 系统化的分解确定拟议组成部分的贡献,辅以特征可视化和空间可靠性分析,这些分析可提供对其互补行为的洞察.

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: • To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to introduce SAM3-based text-conditioned semantic modeling into source-only domain generalization for remote sensing semantic segmentation, providing explicit category guidance beyond source-domain visual observations. • We develop an asymmetric semantic–spatial learning framework with reliability-guided fusion to better exploit task-specific dense representations and strengthen their complementarity with category-level semantic guidance. • We propose Probe-Once Dynamic Adaptive LoRA to control source-specific adaptation under a constrained parameter budget, supporting effective task learning with limited modification of pretrained representations.
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 就我们所知,我们首先将基于SAM3的文字条件语义模型引入了遥感语义分解的唯源域通论,提供了源域视觉观测以外的明确类别指导. ^ 我们开发了一个非对称的语义-空间学习框架,并配有可靠性指导的聚变,以便更好地利用特定任务的密集表述,并加强其与类别层次语义指导的互补性。 我们提议在有限参数预算下控制特定源的适应,支持有效的任务学习,对事先训练过的表述作有限的修改。

blocks.en: To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to introduce SAM3-based text-conditioned semantic modeling into source-only domain generalization for remote sensing semantic segmentation, providing explicit category guidance beyond source-domain visual observations.
blocks.zh: 就我们所知,我们首先将基于SAM3的文本条件语义模型引入了仅用于遥感语义分解的源域通论,提供了源域视觉观测以外的明确类别指导.

blocks.en: We develop an asymmetric semantic–spatial learning framework with reliability-guided fusion to better exploit task-specific dense representations and strengthen their complementarity with category-level semantic guidance.
blocks.zh: 我们开发了一个非对称的语义学-空间学学习框架,并配以可靠性指导的聚变,以便更好地利用特定任务密集的表述,并加强其与类别层次语义指导的互补性.

blocks.en: We propose Probe-Once Dynamic Adaptive LoRA to control source-specific adaptation under a constrained parameter budget, supporting effective task learning with limited modification of pretrained representations.
blocks.zh: 我们提议在有限参数预算下控制特定源的适应,支持有效的任务学习,对预先培训过的表述作有限的修改。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Remote Sensing Semantic Segmentation and Domain Generalization
blocks.zh: 2.1 遥感语义分解和域概论

blocks.en: Remote sensing semantic segmentation assigns pixel-level land-cover labels to aerial or satellite imagery and serves as a fundamental technique for land-cover mapping, urban planning, agricultural monitoring, and environmental analysis ( Zhu et al., 2017 ; Ma et al., 2019 ) . CNN-based methods established dense prediction, encoder-decoder learning, and multi-scale contextual modeling as standard segmentation paradigms ( Long et al., 2015 ; Ronneberger et al., 2015 ; Chen et al., 2018 ; Zhao et al., 2017 ) . More recently, Transformer- and mask-classification-based architectures further improved long-range representation learning and mask-level prediction ( Xie et al., 2021 ; Xiao et al., 2018 ; Cheng et al., 2021 ; Cheng et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 遥感语义分解将像素级土地覆盖物标注在航空或卫星图像上,并作为土地覆盖物测绘,城市规划,农业监测,环境分析的基础技术(朱等,2017;马等,2019). 基于CNN的方法确立了密集预测,编码器-解码器学习,以及多尺度背景模型作为标准分解范式(Long等,2015;Ronneberger等,2015;Chen等,2018;Zhao等,2017.). 最近,"变形"和"口罩分级"架构进一步改善了远程代表学习和口罩水平预测(谢等,2021;萧等,2018;程等,2021;程等,2022.

blocks.en: Despite these advances, remote sensing segmentation remains highly sensitive to domain shifts caused by geographic regions, sensors, spatial resolutions, seasons, and acquisition conditions ( Wang et al., 2021 ; Iizuka et al., 2023 ; Liang et al., 2024 ) . Such shifts may affect not only image appearance but also object scale, spatial layout, land-cover composition, and structural patterns. Domain adaptation alleviates this problem by exploiting target-domain data during training through adversarial alignment, output-space adaptation, self-training, or pseudo-label refinement ( Ganin and Lempitsky, 2015 ; Tsai et al., 2018 ; Hoffman et al., 2018 ; Zou et al., 2019 ; Vu et al., 2019 ) . Remote sensing domain adaptation has likewise been investigated through curriculum learning, adaptive discrimination, and cross-city semantic alignment ( Zhang et al., 2021 ; Chen et al., 2022b ; Hong et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展,遥感分解仍然对地理区域、传感器、空间分辨率、季节和获取条件造成的域位转移具有高度敏感性(Wang等,2021;Iizuka等,2023;Liang等,2024)。 这种变化不仅可能影响图像外观,而且还会影响物体的规模、空间布局、土地覆盖物组成和结构模式。 域适应通过在训练期间通过对抗对接,输出-空间适应,自训,或伪标签完善等手段利用目标域数据来缓解这一问题(Ganin and Lempitsky,2015;Tsai等,2018;Hoffman等,2018;Zou等,2019;Vu等,2019). 同样,通过课程学习、适应性歧视和跨城市语义协调,对遥感领域的适应情况进行了调查(张等,2021;陈等,2022b;洪等,2023)。

blocks.en: Domain generalization (DG), in contrast, trains models only on source-domain data and directly evaluates them on unseen target domains ( Muandet et al., 2013 ; Li et al., 2018 ; Balaji et al., 2018 ; Kim et al., 2021 ; Zhou et al., 2022 ; Rafi et al., 2024 ) . For remote sensing segmentation, FOSMix enhances robustness through frequency-based style mixing ( Iizuka et al., 2023 ) , CCDR constructs auxiliary domains using texture and style randomization while enforcing category consistency ( Liang et al., 2024 ) , and SMGPC combines style mapping with prototype-based contrastive learning for category-level generalization ( Wang et al., 2025b ) . These methods demonstrate the effectiveness of visual-domain diversification and representation regularization. Nevertheless, explicit category semantics beyond source-domain visual observations remain relatively underexplored, particularly for source-only dense prediction under complex remote sensing shifts.
blocks.zh: domain generation (DG),相形之下,只根据源域数据来训练模型,直接在隐形目标域上评价模型(Muandet等,2013;Li等,2018;Balaji等,2018;Kim等,2021;Zhou等,2022;Rafi等,2024). 对于遥感分解,FOSMix通过以频率为主的风格相混合来增强稳健性(Iizuka等,2023年),CCDR使用纹理和样式随机化构建辅助域,同时执行类别一致性(Liang等,2024年),SMGPC将样式相映射与以原型为主的对比性学习结合起来,用于类别层次通化(Wang等,2025b. 这些方法显示了视觉领域多样化和代表性正规化的有效性。 尽管如此,在源域外的视觉观测中,明确分类的语义仍然相对未得到充分的探讨,特别是在复杂的遥感变化中,只进行源密度预测。

blocks.en: 2.2 Vision-Language and Foundation Models for Remote Sensing
blocks.zh: 2.2 遥感远景-语言和基础模型

blocks.en: Large-scale pretraining has substantially improved the transferability of visual representations. Self-supervised models such as MAE, DINO, and DINOv2 learn generic visual features from large image collections ( He et al., 2022 ; Caron et al., 2021 ; Oquab et al., 2024 ) , while CLIP aligns visual representations with natural-language concepts through large-scale image-text supervision ( Radford et al., 2021 ) . This vision-language paradigm has also been extended to dense prediction. LSeg aligns pixel-level visual embeddings with text embeddings for language-driven semantic segmentation ( Li et al., 2022 ) , while DenseCLIP transfers CLIP knowledge from image-text matching to pixel-text matching for dense prediction ( Rao et al., 2022 ) . These studies demonstrate the potential of linguistic semantics to provide explicit category-level guidance beyond purely visual representation learning.
blocks.zh: 大规模预训大大改善了视觉表现的可转移性. 由MAE,DINO,DINov2等自我监督的模型从大型图像集中学习出通用的视觉特征(He等,2022;Caron等,2021;Oquab等,2024;CLIP通过大规模图像文字监督将视觉表达与自然语言概念相协调(Radford等,2021). 这种视觉语言范式也已经扩展到密集的预测. LSeg将像素级视觉嵌入与文字嵌入进行语言驱动语义分解(Li等,2022年)相协调,而 DenseCLIP 将 CLIP 知识从图像文本匹配到像素文本匹配进行密集预测(Rao等,2022年). 这些研究表明,语言语义学除了纯粹的视觉表现学习之外,还有可能提供明确的类别级指导.

blocks.en: Foundation-model pretraining has also been actively explored for remote sensing image understanding. Continual pretraining has been used to construct geospatial foundation representations ( Mendieta et al., 2023 ) , while Scale-MAE and SatMAE incorporate scale, temporal, and multispectral characteristics into remote sensing pretraining ( Reed et al., 2023 ; Cong et al., 2022 ) . SpectralGPT and HyperSIGMA further extend foundation representation learning to spectral remote sensing imagery ( Hong et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) . More recently, CrossEarth demonstrates the potential of geospatial foundation models for domain-generalized remote sensing semantic segmentation ( Gong et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 还积极探索了遥感图像理解的基础模型预培训。 连续的预训被用于构建地理空间地基代表(Mendieta等人,2023年),而SatMAE和SatMAE则将比例、时间和多光谱特征纳入遥感预训(Reed等人,2023年;Cong等人,2022年)。 SpectralGPT和HyperSIGMA进一步将基础表现学扩展至光谱遥感图像(Hong等,2024;Wang等,2025a.). 最近,CrossEarth展示了地理空间基础模型在域通用遥感语义分化方面的潜力(Gong等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Although these studies provide increasingly transferable representations, generic foundation features do not necessarily offer the category-aware semantics and dense spatial representations required by a specific downstream segmentation task. In particular, how to exploit linguistic semantic knowledge together with generic foundation representations for source-only remote sensing domain generalization remains insufficiently explored. Our work addresses this gap by introducing explicit category text into domain-generalized remote sensing semantic segmentation and jointly exploiting category-aware semantic guidance and task-specific dense representations.
blocks.zh: 虽然这些研究提供了越来越多的可转移的表示方式,但一般基础特征不一定提供特定下游分层任务所需的有意识的语义和密集的空间表示方式。 特别是,如何利用语言语义学知识以及仅用于源域遥感泛化的通用基础说明,仍然没有充分探讨。 我们的工作解决了这一差距,将明确的类别文本引入了域通用遥感语义分解,并联合利用了类别感知语义指南和针对具体任务的密集表述。

blocks.en: 2.3 SAM-style Foundation Models for Remote Sensing Interpretation
blocks.zh: 2.3 SAM式遥感解释基础模型

blocks.en: The Segment Anything Model (SAM) learns promptable, class-agnostic segmentation priors from large-scale segmentation data ( Kirillov et al., 2023 ) . Its object-level and structural representations provide a foundation for delineating land-cover objects, motivating efforts to transfer these capabilities to remote sensing imagery.
blocks.zh: 分片任意模式(SAM)从大规模分片数据中学习出可迅速、可知的分片(Kirillov等,2023年)。 其物体级别和结构表述为划定被覆盖地的物体提供了基础,促使人们努力将这些能力转移到遥感图像上。

blocks.en: Such efforts have explored both data construction and model adaptation. SAMRS employs SAM-generated masks to scale up remote sensing segmentation data ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , while RingMo-SAM extends SAM to multimodal remote sensing imagery ( Yan et al., 2023 ) . RSPrompter introduces learnable prompting for remote sensing instance segmentation ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , and MeSAM enhances SAM with multi-scale adaptation for optical remote sensing imagery ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) . These studies establish the utility of general segmentation priors for remote sensing interpretation.
blocks.zh: 这些努力探索了数据构建和模型调整。 SAMRS使用SAM生成的口罩来扩大遥感分解数据(Wang等,2023年),而RingMo-SAM则将SAM扩展至多模式遥感图像(Yan等,2023年). RSPrompter引入了可学习的可促进遥感实例分解(Chen等,2024年),MeSAM通过对光学遥感图像的多尺度改造来增强SAM(Zhou等,2024年)。 这些研究确定了一般分区前科对遥感解释的效用。

blocks.en: More recently, SAM3 has extended promptable segmentation to concept-aware recognition ( Carion et al., 2026 ) , opening further opportunities for category-level remote sensing interpretation. SegEarth-OV3 explores this capability through training-free open-vocabulary segmentation, combining mask outputs and presence-based category filtering ( Li et al., 2025 ) . ProC-SAM3 further develops prompt calibration and presence-guided fusion for remote sensing open-vocabulary semantic segmentation ( Song et al., 2026 ) . These studies demonstrate the potential of concept-aware priors for training-free prediction. Applying such priors to source-only domain generalization introduces a complementary challenge: learning task-specific semantic and spatial representations from a single labeled source domain while preserving transferability to unseen domains with different geographic and imaging conditions.
blocks.zh: 最近,SAM3将可迅速分解的范围扩大到认识概念的识别(Carion等人,2026年),为类别一级的遥感解释提供了进一步的机会。 SegEarth-OV3通过无培训的开放-vobulary分解,结合口罩输出和以存在为基础的类别过滤(Li等,2025年)来探索这种能力. ProC-SAM3进一步发展了遥感开放-活性语义分解(Song等,2026年)的即时校正和存在制导聚变. 这些研究表明,认识概念的前科对于无培训的预测具有潜力。 将这种前科应用于仅源域通论带来了一个互补的挑战:从一个被标注的单一源域学习特定任务语义和空间表现,同时保留可转移性到地理和成像条件不同的看不见域.

blocks.en: 2.4 Parameter-Efficient Adaptation and Reliability-Guided Fusion
blocks.zh: 2.4 参数有效适应和可靠性指导型融合

blocks.en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) adapts pretrained models by updating only a small set of task-specific parameters while keeping most foundation weights frozen. Representative approaches include Adapter tuning, Visual Prompt Tuning, LoRA, and AdaptFormer ( Houlsby et al., 2019 ; Jia et al., 2022 ; Hu et al., 2022 ; Chen et al., 2022a ) . Such strategies are particularly attractive for large foundation models because they reduce adaptation cost while limiting direct modification of pretrained parameters.
blocks.zh: 参数高效的微调(PEFT)通过仅更新一小组任务特有参数,同时使大部分地基重量被冻结来适应预先训练的模型. 具有代表性的方法包括:适应器调试、视觉快速图宁、LORA和适应Former(Houlsby等,2019年;Jia等,2022年;Hu等,2022年;Chen等,2022a年)。 这种战略对大型基础模型特别有吸引力,因为它们既能降低适应成本,又能限制直接修改经过培训的参数。

blocks.en: Recent work further investigates adaptive low-rank allocation. AdaLoRA dynamically reallocates a limited low-rank budget according to parameter importance ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) , whereas DyLoRA trains LoRA modules to operate across a range of ranks without repeated rank-specific retraining ( Valipour et al., 2023 ) . In remote sensing, SpectralX demonstrates the effectiveness of parameter-efficient adaptation for domain-generalized spectral foundation models ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Meanwhile, full fine-tuning has been shown to distort pretrained features and degrade out-of-distribution performance under large distribution shifts ( Kumar et al., 2022 ) . These observations motivate controlled foundation-model adaptation for source-only DG.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作进一步调查了适应性低级别拨款。 AdaLORA根据参数重要性动态地重新分配有限的低级预算(Zhang等,2023年),而DyLORA则训练LORA模块在一系列级别上运行,而无需反复进行分级再培训(Valipour等,2023年). 在遥感方面,SpectralX演示了域通光谱基模型的参数高效适应的有效性(张等,2026). 同时,全面微调被证明扭曲了经过预先训练的特征,并降低了在大型分配班次下的分配外性能(Kumar等人,2022年)。 这些观测激发了受控的基础模型适应只用于源的DG.

blocks.en: Different from existing adaptive LoRA methods developed primarily for general pretrained models, our Dynamic Adaptive LoRA targets hierarchical SAM3 adaptation under a constrained total rank budget. It allocates adaptation capacity according to the contribution of different encoder layers to downstream remote sensing semantic learning, aiming to preserve transferable foundation knowledge while acquiring task-specific representations.
blocks.zh: 与主要为一般预先培训的模型开发的现有适应性LORA方法不同,我们的动态适应性LORA在有限的总排位预算下针对等级的SAM3适应. 它根据不同编码器层对下游遥感语义学习的贡献来分配适应能力,旨在保存可转移的基础知识,同时获取特定任务的说明.

blocks.en: Finally, the adapted semantic branch and frozen dense branch provide complementary information but may exhibit different reliability across categories and unseen domain shifts. A fixed fusion rule implicitly assumes stable branch quality and may therefore be suboptimal. We instead employ reliability-guided class-wise fusion to dynamically integrate category-aware semantic priors and task-specific dense predictions according to their prediction reliability.
blocks.zh: 最后,经调整的语义分支和被冻结的稠密分支提供了补充信息,但可能显示出不同类别和不可见域变化的不同可靠性。 固定的聚变规则隐含地假定了稳定的分支质量,因此可能是次优. 相反,我们利用可靠性指导的分级核聚变,根据预测的可靠性,动态地将类别感知语义前科和任务特有密度预测结合起来。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 概览

blocks.en: ASCoR is trained on a single labeled source domain and evaluated directly on unseen target domains. Each input is a three-channel remote sensing image with pixel-wise land-cover annotations. The framework combines explicit category guidance with task-specific spatial evidence using only source-domain supervision. Target-domain images are not used for parameter optimization.
blocks.zh: ASCoR接受单一标签源域的培训,并直接在看不见的目标域上进行评估. 每个输入是三相道的遥感图像,并带有像素-视地-覆盖说明. 该框架将明确的类别指导与特定任务空间证据相结合,只使用源域监督. 目标域图像不用于参数优化.

blocks.en: The framework consists of a text-conditioned semantic branch (TCSB), a task-specific dense branch (TSDB), and a reliability-guided fusion module. The branches have distinct learning objectives: TCSB uses category prompts to guide semantic discrimination, whereas TSDB extracts spatial evidence targeted at the limitations of the semantic prediction. Their pretrained SAM3 weights remain frozen, with task learning concentrated in the respective adaptation and decoding components. The router subsequently determines where and to what extent the dense evidence should correct TCSB. Superscripts A A and B B denote TCSB and TSDB, respectively; 𝐙 \mathbf{Z} denotes logits, and 𝐏 \mathbf{P} denotes the corresponding class probabilities obtained through softmax.
blocks.zh: 框架由文字条件化的语义分支(TCSB),任务特异的密集分支(TSDB)和可靠性导聚变模块组成. 这些分支有不同的学习目标:TCSB使用类提示来指导语义上的歧视,而TSDB则取出针对语义上预测的局限性的空间证据. 其预受训练的SAM3重量仍然被冻结,任务学习集中在相应的适应和解码组件上. 路由器随后确定密集证据应在何处和在多大程度上纠正TCSB. 上标A和B分别表示TCSB和TSDB;Z\mathbf{Z}表示对数,而P\mathbf{P}表示通过软马克思获得的相应类概率.

blocks.en: 3.2 Text-Conditioned Semantic Branch

blocks.en: TCSB introduces class-name prompts into SAM3 so that category prediction is guided by explicit semantic concepts as well as visual observations. A fixed set of land-cover concepts is used throughout each transfer task, providing a common semantic reference across changes in image appearance. Each prompt produces a dense class response, and these responses are combined into the segmentation logits. For an unprompted background or clutter category, the response is set to the negative maximum foreground response at each pixel.
blocks.zh: TCSB在SAM3中引入了类名提示,这样分类预测就遵循了明确的语义概念以及视觉观察. 在每次传输任务中,都使用一套固定的土地覆盖概念,为图像外观变化提供了共同的语义参考. 每个快取产生密集的类响应,这些响应被组合入分解对数. 对于一个未发音的背景或拼接类,响应设定为每个像素的负最大前缘响应.

blocks.en: 3.3 Task-Specific Dense Branch
blocks.zh: 3.3 特定任务部门

blocks.en: TSDB is designed to learn spatial information that supplements the text-conditioned prediction. Its pretrained SAM3 encoder weights remain frozen, while lightweight adaptation, feature projection, structure injection, and dense decoding modules are trained. Frequency-aware adaptation provides adjustment within the feature hierarchy, and selected hierarchical features are projected into a common embedding space and spatially aligned so that the decoder can combine information from multiple representation levels.
blocks.zh: TSDB旨在学习补充文字条件预测的空间信息. 其预训的SAM3编码器重量仍然被冻结,而轻量级的适应,特征投影,结构注入和密集的解码模块则被训练出. 频率-意识适应在特征分级内提供调整,所选择的分级特征被预测为共同的嵌入空间和空间对接,使解码器能够将来自多代表级别的信息相融合.

blocks.en: 3.5 Optimization and Training Strategy
blocks.zh: 3.5 优化和培训战略

blocks.en: Training proceeds in three sequential stages that separate semantic adaptation, complementary spatial learning, and reliability estimation. First, TCSB undergoes source-domain probing, the rank allocation in Eq. ( 3 ), and the SVD-based conversion in Eq. ( 4 ). It is then adapted with the fixed rank map using supervised cross-entropy and the cosine residual-scale schedule.
blocks.zh: 培训分为三个相继阶段,分别是语义适应、互补的空间学习和可靠性估计。 首先,TCSB进行源域检测,以Eq. (3)进行分级分配,以SVD为基础的转换以Eq. (4)进行. 然后根据固定的军衔图加以调整,采用有监督的交叉纵横和余弦分级表。

blocks.en: Next, TCSB is frozen and provides a fixed semantic reference for TSDB training. Only TSDB’s adaptation, projection, structure, and decoding modules are updated using Eq. ( 8 ). This keeps the basis for complementary supervision fixed while the spatial branch learns. Finally, both segmentation branches are frozen and the router is optimized with Eq. ( 12 ), learning to combine the completed predictors without changing their representations.

blocks.en: At inference, the two branches process the unseen image and the router combines their predictions through Eq. ( 9 ). Each pixel is assigned the category with the highest fused probability. The complete training procedure uses only source-domain supervision.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced ASCoR, an asymmetric dual-branch SAM3 framework for source-only
domain generalization in remote-sensing semantic segmentation. TCSB uses
category-conditioned SAM3 predictions and Probe-Once Dynamic Adaptive LoRA
to preserve transferable semantics under a constrained adaptation budget.
TSDB learns dense multi-scale and structural features from a separate frozen
foundation encoder. A lightweight reliability router combines their
complementary predictions through spatially adaptive correction.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了ASCoR, 一个不对称的双分支 SAM3 框架,只用于源
在遥感语义分解中域通论. TCSB 用途
类别 有条件的 SAM3 预测和探测-后期动态适应LORA
在有限的适应预算之下保留可转让语义。
TSDB从单独的冷冻中学习到密集的多尺度和结构特征
基础编码器。 轻量级可靠性路由器结合它们
通过空间适应性校正进行互补预测.

blocks.en:
Across six ISPRS transfers, ASCoR achieves 68.61% average mIoU and ranks
first on four directions, including the challenging joint geographic–spectral
transfers. The two remaining directions are within 0.56 percentage points
of the best results. ASCoR also attains the highest mIoU on all three
LoveDA/OpenEarthMap transfers, reaching 59.07%, 47.95%, and 49.38%.
Component studies highlight the gains from adaptive rank allocation,
complementary dense representations, and reliability-guided fusion.
The framework updates at most 1.61% of its resident parameters during
any training stage, while router inference adds only 0.29% latency.
These findings establish asymmetric foundation-model adaptation as an
effective strategy for transferable dense land-cover understanding.
blocks.zh:
在6次ISPRS转移中,ASCoR平均达到68.61%的MIOU和排名
首先涉及四个方向,包括具有挑战性的联合地理-光谱
转让。 其余两个方向在0.56个百分点以内
最佳结果。 ASCOR也得到了最高的MIOU 在所有三个
LoveDA/OpenEarthMap转会,达到59.07%,47.95%,49.38%.
组成部分研究强调适应性级别分配的收益,
互补的密集表示, 和可靠性引导聚变。
该框架最多更新了1.61%的常住参数
任何培训阶段,而路由器推论只增加0.29%的延迟。
这些结论将不对称的基础模型适应确定为一种
制定有效战略,以了解可转移的密集土地覆盖。
